text.tspan: Every paper (and slide deck) opens here: a
toolbox on the left, the source document
itself on the right. This is also where a
citation preview links back to when you click
Navigate searches this document's own text and
browses its table of contents. Jump goes
straight to a page, a chunk, or an exact
phrase. Sources and Cited are the S2
Semantic search finds passages by meaning,
keyword by exact words; TOC browses the
outline; Raw reads the ingested body verbatim
when there's no PDF to fall back on. Click a
The actual PDF, rendered in place — every jump
from the sidebar scrolls it to the matching
page or passage. A stub with no PDF on disk
still gets Navigate and Jump over whatever
